expected: Opens with the run line (build_graph.py --spec … --out-dir …) and names validation.json, graph.md and graph.py

graph.py shape has a TypedDict State with docs as Annotated[list, operator.add] and is described as generated and syntax-checked, not executed

cases.prompt:
Here's my inbox router graph — check it and draw it.
{"name":"inbox_router","state":[{"name":"email","type":"str"},{"name":"category","type":"str"},{"name":"reply","type":"str"}],"nodes":[{"name":"classify","kind":"llm","description":"Classify the email","reads":["email"],"writes":["category"]},{"name":"route","kind":"router","description":"Route by category","reads":["category"]},{"name":"billing","kind":"llm","description":"Draft billing reply","reads":["email"],"writes":["reply"]},{"name":"tech","kind":"llm","description":"Draft tech reply","reads":["email"],"writes":["reply"]}],"edges":[{"from":"classify","to":"route"}],"conditional_edges":[{"from":"route","routes":{"billing":"billing","tech":"tech"}}],"entry":"classify","finish":["billing","tech"]}
expected: Reports valid: true (exit 0); the router 'route' has two routes so the router rule passes
Diagram shows classify → route with labelled conditional edges to billing and tech, both reaching END
Scaffold shape includes a route_route function returning Literal['billing', 'tech'] and add_conditional_edges wiring
States the scaffold is syntax-checked, not executed

cases.prompt:
ReAct-style loop. Will this graph loop forever?
{"name":"tool_agent","state":[{"name":"messages","type":"messages","reducer":"add_messages"}],"nodes":[{"name":"agent","kind":"llm","description":"Decide next tool call","reads":["messages"],"writes":["messages"]},{"name":"tools","kind":"tool","description":"Execute the tool call","reads":["messages"],"writes":["messages"]}],"edges":[{"from":"tools","to":"agent"}],"conditional_edges":[{"from":"agent","routes":{"call_tool":"tools","done":"END"}}],"entry":"agent","finish":[]}
expected: Identifies the agent ↔ tools cycle and that it has a conditional exit (agent -[done]-> END), so it is not an infinite loop
Reports valid: true (exit 0); add_messages is compatible with the messages field
Notes that whether the done route is ever taken depends on the router code, and the scaffold is syntax-checked, not executed

cases.prompt:
Scan pipeline spec, please validate:
{"name":"code_scan","state":[{"name":"doc","type":"str"},{"name":"findings","type":"list"},{"name":"summary","type":"str"}],"nodes":[{"name":"scan_a","kind":"function","description":"Static rules","reads":["doc"],"writes":["findings"]},{"name":"scan_b","kind":"llm","description":"LLM review","reads":["doc"],"writes":["findings"]},{"name":"report","kind":"llm","description":"Summarise findings","reads":["findings"],"writes":["summary"]}],"edges":[{"from":"scan_a","to":"scan_b"},{"from":"scan_b","to":"report"}],"conditional_edges":[],"entry":"scan_a","finish":["report"]}
expected: Reports valid: true (exit 0) with a warning that list field 'findings' is written by scan_a and scan_b without a reducer (last write wins)

cases.prompt:
Order check graph. Anything wrong?
{"name":"order_check","state":[{"name":"order","type":"dict"},{"name":"status","type":"str"}],"nodes":[{"name":"check","kind":"llm","description":"Validate the order","reads":["order"],"writes":["status"]},{"name":"log","kind":"function","description":"Audit log","reads":["status"],"writes":[]},{"name":"repair","kind":"llm","description":"Fix the order","reads":["order"],"writes":["order"]}],"edges":[{"from":"check","to":"log"},{"from":"repair","to":"check"}],"conditional_edges":[{"from":"check","routes":{"ok":"END","fix":"repair"}}],"entry":"check","finish":["log"]}
expected: Reports valid: true (exit 0) with the warning that node 'check' has static AND conditional out-edges, so both execute on every run
Recommends moving the log step into the conditional routes or after them unless both branches are meant to run
Confirms the check ↔ repair cycle has a conditional exit

cases.prompt:
